jobs.title: SAP IS-U Billing Functional Lead Consultant
jobs.description:
SAP IS\-U Billing Functional Lead Consultant
 



 Job Location: Remote
 



 Duration: 12\+ Months Contract with Possible extension
 



 Visa: GC or USC
 



  





**Job Summary** 




  





 We are seeking an experienced SAP IS\-U Billing Functional Consultant with strong hands\-on expertise in SAP Industry Solutions for Utilities, specifically IS\-U Billing. The ideal consultant will have a solid understanding of end\-to\-end utility billing processes and the ability to work closely with business stakeholders, functional teams, and technical teams to analyze requirements, configure solutions, troubleshoot issues, and support project delivery.
 



  





 The consultant should have recent, hands\-on experience working with SAP IS\-U Billing and be comfortable operating independently in a client\-facing environment. Experience supporting complex utility billing processes, integrations, testing, and production issues is highly valued.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead and support SAP IS\-U Billing functional activities throughout the project lifecycle.
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into effective SAP IS\-U Billing solutions.
* Perform functional configuration and customization within the SAP IS\-U Billing module.
* Work with business stakeholders to understand utility billing requirements, business processes, and pain points.
* Design and document end\-to\-end billing processes and functional solutions.
* Configure and support billing\-related master data, billing parameters, rates, and billing processes.
* Analyze and resolve billing errors, exceptions, and production issues.
* Investigate complex billing scenarios and determine root causes across functional processes and integrations.
* Work closely with technical teams on functional specifications, enhancements, interfaces, reports, and custom developments.
* Review technical solutions to ensure they align with SAP IS\-U Billing business requirements.
* Participate in requirements gathering, process design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post\-production support.
* Develop functional specifications and detailed business/process documentation as required.
* Support SIT, UAT, regression testing, and defect resolution.
* Prepare and execute functional test scenarios covering various utility billing scenarios.
* Collaborate with integration teams to validate data flow between IS\-U Billing and related SAP/non\-SAP systems.
* Support data validation, reconciliation, and issue resolution during testing and implementation.
* Participate in cutover, go\-live, hypercare, and production support activities.
* Provide functional guidance and knowledge transfer to other team members.
* Identify opportunities to improve billing processes, controls, and operational efficiency.
* Communicate effectively with technical teams, business users, project managers, and other functional teams.

jobs.title: SAP ABAP Senior Consultant
jobs.description:
**Role Summary** 




  





**SAP ABAP Senior Consultant Profile (10\+ Years, AMS, US Customers)** 




**Location – Bengaluru/Hyderabad** 









**We are seeking Senior SAP ABAP Consultant below for your ready reference and please share updated resume and Checklist xls attached duly filled** 









**Profile Summary:** 




**Accomplished and detail\-oriented Senior SAP ABAP Consultant with over 10\+ years of extensive experience, including specialized expertise in SAP HRM/HCM and SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management). Skilled in developing scalable, high\-performance ABAP solutions across multiple SAP modules such as SD, MM, FI/CO, HR, and BRIM (SAP Convergent Charging, CI, CM, SOM). Adept at delivering end\-to\-end implementations, custom enhancements, and performance\-optimized interfaces. Proficient in Object\-Oriented ABAP, ALV reports, Web Dynpro, ABAP on HANA, CDS Views, OData services, and RESTful APIs. Demonstrated ability in integrating SAP BRIM components with external systems via RFC, BAPI, and REST services, and customizing HR processes using PA/OM, Payroll, Time Management, and ESS/MSS frameworks.** 




**Collaborates effectively with functional teams and stakeholders, delivering reliable and maintainable code aligned with business requirements. Experience working in Agile/DevOps environments with strong documentation, mentoring, and project delivery skills.** 




  





**Core Competencies:** 



* **SAP ABAP (Classical, OO, ALV, Reports, Dialog Programming)**
* **HR ABAP (Info types, Clusters, Payroll Schemas, Time Evaluation)**
* **SAP HCM Modules: PA, OM, Payroll, Time, Benefits, ESS/MSS**
* **SAP BRIM Modules: CI (Convergent Invoicing), CC (Convergent Charging), CM (Contract Management), Subscription Order Management (SOM)**
* **Enhancements: BADIs, User Exits, Customer Exits, Enhancement Points**
* **Adobe Forms, Smart Forms, SAP Scripts**
* **Data Migration: BDC, LSMW, BAPIs**
* **SAP Fiori / UI5 App Extension \& OData Development**
* **CDS Views, AMDP, Code Pushdown in S/4HANA**
* **Integration: IDoc, ALE, BAPI, Web Services, REST APIs**
* **Performance Tuning \& Code Optimization**
* **DevOps tools: Git, Jenkins, SAP ChaRM, Solution Manager**



  





**Certifications:** 



* **SAP Certified Development Associate – ABAP with SAP NetWeaver**
* **SAP Certified Application Associate – SAP BRIM**
* **SAP HCM/HRM Functional Overview Training (Optional)**



  





**Professional Experience Highlights:** 



* **Developed custom payroll reports and enhanced infotype processing logic using HCM\-specific ABAP constructs for a government HR project.**
* **Automated leave management and time evaluation through custom workflows integrated with MSS/ESS portals.**
* **Delivered multiple enhancements in SAP BRIM, including custom logic in SAP CI billing documents, custom charging rules in SAP CC, and BAPI\-based integration with external rating engines.**
* **Developed subscription lifecycle reports and mass contract upload programs for SAP Subscription Order Management (SOM).**
* **Built and optimized OData services and Fiori/UI5 interfaces to expose BRIM and HR data securely to front\-end applications.**
* **Supported multiple SAP S/4HANA migration projects by redesigning classic ABAP logic to leverage CDS views, AMDP, and clean core extension practices.**



  





**Education:** 



* **Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field**

jobs.title: SAP -  RAR - Manager - Pune
jobs.description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As a SAP RAR Manager, you will play a pivotal role in helping clients optimize their SAP Customer Relationship Management processes. You will analyze client requirements, implement CRM software solutions, and provide training and support for seamless integration and utilization of SAP CRM applications. Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will leverage your skills to enhance customer satisfaction and achieve strategic objectives.
   

  

 As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team member’s unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will utilize your expertise in SAP RAR module implementation, configuration, and integration with SAP SD and BRIM modules, driving impactful solutions for our clients.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Leading the implementation and integration of SAP CRM solutions to optimize client relationship management processes
* Analyzing client requirements and designing tailored SAP RAR solutions to meet strategic objectives
* Managing end\-to\-end project lifecycles, including requirement gathering, blue printing, and functional testing
* Configuring SAP RAR modules and integrating them with SAP SD and BRIM for seamless data migration
* Developing and executing testing plans and scripts to validate system functionality and performance
* Overseeing the setup of Revenue Accounting Items and maintaining decision tables within BRF\+ applications
* Providing training and support to clients for effective utilization of SAP CRM applications
* Collaborating with cross\-functional teams to enhance customer satisfaction and engagement
* Utilizing analytical thinking to extract insights from industry trends and inform strategic planning
* Reviewing project deliverables for quality and relevance, confirming alignment with client needs


 What You Must Have
   

  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 4 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required


 What Sets You Apart
   

  

* At least one of the following: One or more SAP certifications in SAP Customer or S/4HANA customer\-facing solutions, including Sales, Service, Commerce, or Customer Data platforms
* Demonstrating experience with SAP RAR module implementations
* Configuring and integrating SAP RAR with SAP SD and BRIM
* Designing source data extraction and transformation for SAP RAR
* Developing testing plans and test scripts for SAP solutions
* Understanding IFRS 15 Revenue SSP Allocation regulations
* Managing Revenue Recognition model setup for various fulfillment events

jobs.description:
The KPMG Advisory practice is at the forefront of transformation, offering excellent opportunities for individuals to advance their careers and expertise with KPMG. Looking ahead, we anticipate continued evolution and success within the practice, fostering both personal and professional development, thereby creating new pathways for growth. In this ever\-changing market environment, our professionals must be adaptable and thrive in a collaborative, team\-driven culture. At KPMG, our people are our number one priority. With a wealth of learning and career development opportunities, a world\-class training facility, and leading market tools, we help our people continue to grow both professionally and personally. If you're looking for a firm with a strong team connection where you can be your whole self, have an impact, advance your skills, deepen your experiences, and have the flexibility and access to constantly find new areas of inspiration and expand your capabilities, then consider a career in Advisory.
   

  

 KPMG is currently seeking a Director, SAP IS\-U \-Power \& Utilities for our Consulting practice.
   

  

 Responsibilities:
   

  

* Direct and oversee SAP IS\-U back office implementations, ensuring alignment with overall business objectives and utility industry best practices.
* Subject matter expert and architectural leader for the core pieces of the SAP IS\-U landscape, specifically: oversees complex billing execution, invoicing processes, and print workbench configurations, manages the structuring of rates, billing schemas, and variant programs, FI\-CA (Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable): directs the financial backbone of the IS\-U solution, including dunning, payments, collections, and sub\-ledger accounting, and oversees meter readings, installations, replacements, and integration with Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI).
* Drives seamless integration between IS\-U back office functions and other critical SAP modules, including SAP CRM (Customer Relationship Management) for front\-office operations and SAP EAM (Enterprise Asset Management) for asset lifecycle and work management.
* Leads project workstreams, manages resource allocation, and oversees financial management for large\-scale S/4HANA migration programs.
* Acts as a trusted advisor to C\-level utility clients, guiding them through complex business transformations, process improvements, and technology adoption.
* Mentors and manages teams of architects, functional consultants, and developers to deliver high\-quality SAP solutions.
* Act with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility to uphold KPMG's respectful and courteous work environment.


 Qualifications:
   

  

* Ten years of deep domain experience within the Utilities sector (Power, Gas, or Water).
* Extensive, hands\-on architectural experience with SAP IS\-U, with deep specialization in Billing, Rates, Invoicing, FI\-CA, and Device Management.
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end business processes and integration touchpoints with SAP CRM/C4C, SAP EAM, and SAP FI/CO
* Proven track record in driving internal transformation initiatives and effectively influencing cross\-functional teams
* Demonstrated ability to manage large consulting teams, oversee complex project workstreams, and navigate executive\-level stakeholder relationships.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field.


 Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment\-based visa sponsorship now or in the future; KPMG LLP will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H\-1B, L\-1, TN, O\-1, E\-3, H\-1B1, F\-1, J\-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment\-based visa)

* Confidence working within an offshore/onshore delivery model
* Proven expedience large stream of work across multiple locations

+ Company Code Setup
+ Chart of Accounts and GL setup
+ Main / Sub Transaction Setup
+ Security Deposit Process
+ Incoming Payments (Real Time, Direct Debit, Cash Desk, etc.)
+ Outgoing Payments and Returns
+ Collection process using Collection Strategy
+ Collection Agency related process
+ Transfer Posting process
+ Escheatment process

* Strong knowledge of month\-end and period\-end closing and FICA to FICO GL integration.
* Implementation experience of BRF Plus.
* Experience and knowledge of using middleware technology to integrate SAP with third party systems for payments, collection agencies, etc.
* Experience in data migration.
* Can work under minimum supervision, good time management and work planning


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* College degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences
* Approximately 5 to 8 years of experience in a functional role. Able to exhibit a progression of increasingly complex job responsibilities during the period
* Prior SAP BRIM CI role is a must
* Should have worked on minimum 1 implementation from scratch as a lead consultant.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience on integration with third\-party applications
* Knowledge of integration with SAP RAR, BRIM CI/SOM/CM
* Hands on experience in SAP S4 HANA Platform
* Experience on tools like JIRA or equivalent tool to maintain stories.
* SAP Utilities certifications are a plus:
+ Certification in SAP FICA (IUT240 / AC240 / BR240\)
+ Certifications in SAP BRIM Convergent Invoicing (AC245 / BR245\)


**Technologies and Tools**
* SAP FI\-CA / FI\-CAX
* SAP FIORI
* Jira or similar tools
* Azure DevOps or similar tools


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team in the integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Utilities practices globally with leading businesses across a range of geographies

jobs.title: BRIM Technical Architect
jobs.description:
What You'll Do:
   

  

 Own the technical architecture of the SAP BRIM platform — how it is built, integrated, and kept scalable over time. You define how the Order\-to\-Cash (O2C) solution is structured technically: the billing and subscription models at implementation level, the integration architecture, the cross\-module technical coherence, and the extensibility patterns that keep the platform upgrade\-safe and maintainable as Criteo's monetization evolves.
   

  

 Beyond delivery, you are a strategic thinking partner — contributing to the definition of the future billing platform: what monetization capabilities Criteo needs to build, what the platform should become, and how technical architecture choices today shape product options tomorrow.
   

  

 Main missions:
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end technical architecture across BRIM modules, ensuring cross\-module coherence at implementation level (CI, SOM, CM, CC, FI\-CA) within the O2C flow
* Define and own the billing and subscription model implementation: rating architecture, pricing and charging structures, contract and entitlement lifecycle at technical level.
* Own the integration architecture between BRIM, S/4HANA FI and non\-SAP systems — interface contracts, data flows, error handling patterns, API and event\-based integration.
* Ensure the platform remains extensible, upgrade\-safe and Clean Core compliant — define the extensibility patterns (standard APIs, events) that govern how the ABAP Lead builds.
* Translate functional designs into implementable technical blueprints, surfacing constraints, trade\-offs and platform limitations before build starts.
* Partner with the BRIM Product Lead to help defining the future billing platform vision — translating market, business and monetization evolutions into technical architecture directions and platform investment options.


 Tasks:
   

  

* Define the technical implementation of monetization models: subscription structures, rating and pricing mechanics, billing cycle architecture, revenue and collection flows at system level.
* Design integration patterns and interface contracts (inbound/outbound, event\-driven, API\-based) between BRIM and adjacent systems; own technical decisions on error handling, retry, and reconciliation.
* Validate technical feasibility of functional designs produced by the Solution Architect; identify cross\-module technical impacts and escalate conflicts or constraints before they reach build.
* Define extensibility standards and Clean Core guardrails for the ABAP Lead: which enhancement frameworks to use, where custom code is justified, how extensions are structured to remain upgrade\-safe.
* Contribute to BRIM product roadmap discussions with the Product Lead: surface technical constraints, platform opportunities and build\-vs\-standard trade\-offs that shape future product decisions."
* Anticipate evolutions in Criteo's monetization model and translate them into forward\-looking architecture options — new billing constructs, extensibility needs, integration patterns — before they become urgent delivery requirements.
* Provide technical architecture inputs to backlog refinement: effort drivers, implementation options, technical risks, dependency sequencing.
* Produce and maintain the BRIM technical architecture documentation: module interaction model, integration blueprint, master and transactional data architecture, key identifiers across BRIM and S/4HANA.
* Anticipate SAP platform evolutions (S/4HANA releases, BTP where applicable) and maintain a technical roadmap that keeps the BRIM estate extensible and forward\-compatible.
* Lead and contribute to architecture workshops with Solution Architect, ABAP Lead and BRIM components Leads.
* Support delivery teams during complex build, test and hypercare phases on architecture\-level technical issues.


 Who You Are:
   

  

* 8\+ years in SAP architecture and delivery, with deep end\-to\-end ownership of BRIM technical implementations.
* Strong cross\-module expertise in SAP BRIM — with solid working knowledge of SOM, CC, CI and CM integration patterns.
* Proven track record designing and governing billing model architectures: subscription, rating, pricing, invoicing and collection flows at technical implementation level.
* Solid experience defining integration architectures between SAP BRIM / S/4HANA and cloud or non\-SAP systems.
* Strong command of SAP extensibility frameworks (standard APIs, events) and Clean Core principles — able to set the standard others build to.
* Able to translate functional solution designs into technical blueprints and surface implementation constraints before they become delivery risks.
* Ability to think beyond delivery — engaging on product vision, monetization strategy and platform futures with business and product stakeholders, not just with engineering teams.
* Experience working in international, distributed and offshore environments; comfortable aligning remote technical teams to architectural decisions.
* Strong communication skills — able to engage both Business and Engineering stakeholders, and to make architecture trade\-offs legible to non\-architects.


 We acknowledge that many candidates may not meet every single role requirement listed above. If your experience looks a little different from our requirements but you believe that you can still bring value to the role, we’d love to see your application!
   

  

 Who We Are:
   

  

 We’re Criteo, the Commerce Intelligence Platform. Criteo helps businesses turn shopper signals into commerce outcomes while delivering more relevant experiences for shoppers. We use proprietary commerce intelligence and AI decisioning to drive relevance for shoppers and performance for businesses.
   

  

 At Criteo, our culture is as unique as it is diverse. From our offices across the globe or from the comfort of home, our 3,600 Criteos collaborate together to build an open, impactful, and forward\-thinking environment.

**Job Title: SAP BRIM Functional Consultant** 




**Location: New York** 




  





**Position Overview**




 We are looking for an experienced SAP BRIM Functional Consultant with strong hands\-on experience across SAP Convergent Invoicing (CI), Subscription Order Management (SOM), and FI\-CA.
 



 The ideal candidate will have experience working with usage/event data generated by upstream SAP Convergent Mediation (CM) and will be responsible for understanding and ingesting that data, defining the required downstream processing, and supporting the creation and processing of BITs.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**



* Work as a functional SME across the SAP BRIM landscape, with a focus on CI, SOM, and FICA.
* Understand business requirements and translate them into functional BRIM solutions.
* Analyze event data received from SAP Convergent Mediation (CM). Understand the structure, content, and business meaning of CM output data and determine how it should be processed within BRIM.
* Define the required mappings and transformations from incoming usage/event data into BITs. Ensure the appropriate BITs are created from the incoming usage/event data and are available for downstream processing.
* Work with technical teams to ingest and validate data received from CM.
* Support the end\-to\-end flow from CM output → data ingestion → BIT creation → Billing/Invoicing → FI\-CA.
* Support FI\-CA processes including account determination, postings, invoicing, payments, and receivables.
* Troubleshoot functional issues by tracing data across the BRIM landscape and identifying where processing or data discrepancies occur.
* Work closely with developers and integration teams on data mappings, interfaces, transformations, and BRIM integrations.
* Create functional specifications, mapping documents, and business process documentation.
* Support SIT, UAT, regression testing, and production issue resolution.
* Perform end\-to\-end reconciliation to ensure that incoming usage data results in the expected charging, billing, and financial postings.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders and technical teams to resolve functional issues and validate expected outcomes.



  





**Required Experience:**



* 10\+ years SAP BRIM functional experience/Multiple Hands\-on BRIM Projects
* Strong hands\-on experience with SAP CI, SOM, and FI\-CA.
* Experience working with event data received from SAP Convergent Mediation (CM).
* Experience writing functional specifications and working with technical teams to implement integrations and data transformations.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Experience working with subscription products would be preferred.
